Omit for a project-relative path. project-parent uses a relative sibling path; external-exact uses a reviewed absolute local path outside the project parent. On Windows, unc-virtual maps an exact UNC name to local temporary data without contacting the share or inspecting its metadata. All scopes require explicit review. Device paths, traversal and source overlap are rejected; virtual UNC is not network authorization.
